title: How the Public tier appears in the management API

prose.text: The Public tier is visible to the API only indirectly.

prose.label: Instances.
prose.text: {{instance-records-are-private}} The endpoints are in [[zpa.private-service-edges.api-surface]]; the Terraform data source is [[zpa.private-service-edges.terraform:controller-data-source]].

checks.do: Whether the object is an organization instance: /serviceEdge records are described as Private Service Edges, with provisioning key and enrollment certificate members.
Whether upgrade_priority is set, whose values and effect are not documented.

instance-records-are-private.statement: The /serviceEdge API object is documented as a ZPA Private Service Edge and carries provisioning key members, so the API surface for instances is the organization's enrolled Private Service Edges; no operation enrolls or configures a Public Service Edge.

expect.description: The start time of the ZPA Private Service Edge.
The name of the ZPA Private Service Edge provisioning key.

instance-records-are-private.conditions: Absence: no operation under the serviceEdge paths of the OpenAPI document creates an instance or targets a Public Service Edge.

upgrade-priority.title: Allowed values and effect of upgradePriority on service edge groups
upgrade-priority.detail: The Python ServiceEdgeGroup model exposes upgrade_priority (wire key upgradePriority), and no registered source defines its allowed values or effect for the ZPA service edge tier. Resolve with the API reference or a lab test.
